title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=\frac{1}{x}$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{2-1}{5}=0.2$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$1$$, $$1.2$$, $$1.4$$, $$1.6$$, $$1.8$$ and $$2$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$T_5=0.1\left(f{\left(1\right)}+2f{\left(1.2\right)}+2f{\left(1.4\right)}+2f{\left(1.6\right)}+2f{\left(1.8\right)}+f{\left(2\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$0.696$$.
